faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Plant Protection Office Dhanbad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Crop Protector (Kamdar) posts is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the office before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Crop Protector (Kamdar) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Crop Protector (Kamdar) position in the Junior Plant Protection Office Dhanbad Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed Matriculation from a recognized institution and possess a 5-day training from the Agriculture and Horticulture Directorate.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Crop Protector (Kamdar) post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Crop Protector (Kamdar) post is between 18 years and 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Crop Protector (Kamdar) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 11851.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What are the additional skills required for the Crop Protector (Kamdar) role?
faq.answer: Apart from the educational qualifications, candidates must have knowledge of the local language of Dhanbad district and the ability to climb trees and ride a bicycle.

faq.question: Q9. How will the selection be done?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a merit list prepared from General Hindi, Local Language, and Character Certificate.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Junior Plant Protection Office Dhanbad, which is www.dhanbad.nic.in.
